baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Warriors of Chaos (Norse tribes); WH: The Old World (2023+) Rulebook, Norsca; inferred where the books are silent; canon: WFB Warhammer Armies: Norsca (tribes led by Chieftains and Jarls); the mod's tribal law is law_chiefdom (#9037)
baseline.why: Norse tribes are jarl-led raiding confederacies: warrior caste, thing-moot assembly, consumption taxes, slave-taking, no schools or police; standing_army/urbanization is the floor of a tribal but organised host; tribal Norse realms are Chiefdoms under a Chieftain, not monarchies (#9037)

skaven_placeholder.source: canon: WFB 8e Skaven army book (clans under Warlords, Grey Seers of the Horned Rat, slave-taking); placeholder clans, no named canon clan
skaven_placeholder.why: An unnamed Skaven clan is a warlord-ruled swarm with no schooling, tribute-taxed and slave-raiding; held at tier 6 for lack of a clan-specific source; keeps the monarchy baseline: not a Norse tribe (#9037)

wood_elf_realm.source: canon: WFB 8e Wood Elves army book (Athel Loren and the Asrai enclaves ruled by Glade Lords and Spellweavers, closed to outsiders); TW:WH2 Wood Elves
wood_elf_realm.why: Secretive forest realms: warrior-caste Glade Guard, no trade or migration, little taxation, no slavery, no schooling beyond the Spellsingers' lore; held at tier 6 as the mod's lowest elven rung (no industry); keeps the monarchy baseline: not a Norse tribe (#9037)
